data.description_suggestion: Validates one or more email addresses for disposable indicators, format, DNS/MX records, role accounts, and free providers. Accepts email in request body. Always inspect response structure to handle both synchronous results and queued job responses.

data.current_description:
Retrieve temporary results within 15 minutes. Normally returns a plain-text
list of valid entries, not a JSON map of every verdict. Incomplete jobs
return JSON progress; completed jobs without a result file can return
JSON stats instead. Inspect Content-Type before parsing.
Use the originating IP; job records can also authorize the submitting
client account. Viewing results consumes no validation quota but is still
request-rate limited. Download/separator suffixes are described in the bulk guide.
data.description_suggestion: Retrieves results from a bulk validation job using the session ID. Results are available for 15 minutes after job completion. Response format varies by job state and availability: incomplete jobs return JSON progress object with completion percentage; completed jobs return either a plain-text list of valid entries (default) or JSON statistics if no result file is available. Always inspect the Content-Type header to determine response format before parsing. Authorization uses the originating IP address or the submitting client account. Viewing results does not consume validation quota but is subject to per-minute request rate limits.
